comment: mhitu.c mattacku() 568-580: a debug Valkyrie wishes for a pool under herself, steps east, creates a giant eel (placed in the pool) and kills the kobold beside her. She #polyselfs into an iron piercer and hides on the ceiling with #monster. When the eel attacks the hidden hero, the ceiling-hider branch removes it from the map, but a fish in water beside a hero on land will not swap places, so 'It draws back as you drop!' prints and both stay put.
